saw_lines: Fragrance is chosen by smell, and most buyers want a sample or a friend’s nod before they commit to a bottle.
So the sale is won or lost in the first ad, with no proof or offer to tip the buyer.
Your 30 live ads show no proof number, so collect one real figure like orders shipped and put it on every ad as the opening line.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 16 Oct 2026
points: None of your 30 live ads shows a proof number, so a new buyer has no reason to trust the scent. Collect one real figure, such as orders shipped, and put it on every ad as the opening line.

9 of your 30 ads open on the same line, “discover Vendetta, the new fragrance,” so buyers see one story repeatedly. Test two new angles against it, a wear occasion and a customer quote, each in three video cuts.
None of your 30 ads carries an offer, so a first time buyer has no reason to act today. Put a first order offer or a bundle in the opening line of three new ads.
Shop now and Learn more split 19 and 10 ads, with 11 landing pages behind them, so each click gets a mixed ask. Pick one button per page and match it to what the page sells.

ads_1: Scent led video cuts opening on a wear occasion, with proof in line one
soc_1: Brand social strategy for the channels your buyers already use
